At some point in history, food manufacturers stopped appealing to our taste buds. Instead, they began targeting the mechanisms in our brain that make us want more and more of it.

In this video, we break down the tricks food engineers use to keep you addicted to junk food, the advertising tricks brands use to convince you their unhealthy food is actually healthy, and how big food companies treat India as nothing more than an experimental lab of over a billion people.

If you're wondering where to begin your journey of overcoming your uncontrollable cravings, this is a good first step.
